task.title: Common Tasks
task.shortdesc: Learn how to perform the most common tasks in .

context.p: This section walks you through everyday tasks you will perform with .

step.cmd: Create a new project by selecting File New Project .
Enter a name for your project and choose a location to save it.
Add content to your project by using the available tools in the toolbar.
Save your work by pressing Ctrl+S (Windows/Linux) or Cmd+S (macOS).

result.p: You have created and saved your first project in .
